summary: Updates the specification of the IPv4 Identification field. The old rule required uniqueness for every datagram, which would limit connections to about 6.4 Mbps for typical sizes, so this document relaxes it for cases where fragmentation is not used, and updates related rules.

eli5.summary: Every package got a one-of-a-kind number, but fast delivery runs out of numbers. This relaxes the rule when a package is not going to be split up.

questions: what is the ipv4 id field used for
does the ipv4 identification field need to be unique
